ammora.ponder.terminal_redstone.header: Exchange Terminal: Redstone and Stock Index
ammora.ponder.terminal_redstone.text_1: The Exchange Terminal outputs a redstone signal to comparators placed behind it.
ammora.ponder.terminal_redstone.text_2: Analog Mode (Stock): Signal strength 0–15 represents the warehouse fill level of the selected asset.
ammora.ponder.terminal_redstone.text_3: Threshold Mode (Broker): Emits maximum signal 15 when spot price crosses the configured threshold.
ammora.ponder.terminal_display.header: Exchange Terminal: Live Quotes on Flap Displays
ammora.ponder.terminal_display.text_1: The Exchange Terminal integrates with the Display Link mechanism from Create.
ammora.ponder.terminal_display.text_2: Attach a Display Link to the Terminal and bind it to a Display Board.
ammora.ponder.terminal_display.text_3: The Display Board renders real-time quotes: Spot price, daily trend, and market news.
ammora.ponder.trade_dock.header: Trade Dock: Auto-Selling and Create Kinetics
ammora.ponder.trade_dock.text_1: The Trade Dock automatically accepts items from above and sells them on the exchange.
ammora.ponder.trade_dock.text_2: Stop-Loss feature: Configure minimum sell price threshold in the Dock interface.
ammora.ponder.trade_dock.text_3: Kinetic acceleration: Supplying rotational power increases speed up to 1 item/tick (128+ RPM)!
ammora.ponder.purchase_dock.text_1: The Purchase Dock buys commodities using the bound player's account balance.
ammora.ponder.purchase_dock.text_2: Pulse with redstone to initiate a purchase batch.
ammora.ponder.purchase_dock.text_3: Stop-High Protection: Purchases only execute when exchange price does not exceed your limit.

gui.ammora.guide.spot.title: §a§l[SPOT] Commodity Spot Exchange
gui.ammora.guide.spot.line1: §f• Trade inventory resources for CBX at market price.
gui.ammora.guide.spot.line2: §f• AMM formula: shortage raises price, surplus lowers it.
gui.ammora.guide.spot.line3: §e• Slippage: large orders shift the average execution price.
gui.ammora.guide.spot.line4: §c• Eco-fee: when stock >100%%, surplus requires a disposal fee
gui.ammora.guide.spot.line6: §b• MAX button: auto-calculate max volume by balance or bag.
gui.ammora.guide.spot.line7: §a• Daily trend: market prices adjust by up to ±10%% at midnight.
gui.ammora.guide.spot.line8: §8• Supports 8 commodities from copper to netherite.
gui.ammora.guide.oms.title: §e§l[UMA] Unallocated Metal Accounts
gui.ammora.guide.oms.line1: §f• Invest in commodities directly in CBX without physical chests.
gui.ammora.guide.oms.line2: §f• Purchase virtual ounces at current spot prices.
gui.ammora.guide.oms.line3: §a• Live PnL: real-time profit and loss tracking.
gui.ammora.guide.oms.line4: §f• Closing: cash out virtual units at the prevailing spot rate.
gui.ammora.guide.oms.line5: §6• Carry Fee: 0.05%% maintenance fee debited daily at midnight
gui.ammora.guide.oms.line7: §b• Quick entry: 50 CBX, 100 CBX, 500 CBX, MAX presets.
gui.ammora.guide.oms.line8: §8• Long-term trend investment without inventory clutter.
gui.ammora.guide.limit.title: §b§l[LIMIT] Limit Order Book
gui.ammora.guide.limit.line1: §f• Buy below or sell above current market price.
gui.ammora.guide.limit.line2: §a• BUY LIMIT: funds reserved; triggers automatically on dips
gui.ammora.guide.limit.line3: §8returning any price difference to your balance.
gui.ammora.guide.limit.line4: §c• SELL LIMIT: automatic sell order upon price peaks.
gui.ammora.guide.limit.line5: §e• Fine increments: +/-0.01 CBX and +/-0.10 CBX buttons.
gui.ammora.guide.limit.line6: §d• [SPOT] button: syncs order price with current market.
gui.ammora.guide.limit.line7: §f• [❌] button: cancels order and refunds reserved funds.
gui.ammora.guide.limit.line8: §8• Server-side matching engine processes orders every second.
gui.ammora.guide.contracts.title: §d§l[DELIVERY] Delivery Contracts
gui.ammora.guide.contracts.line1: §f• Time-sensitive delivery contracts for the exchange.
gui.ammora.guide.contracts.line2: §a• Premium payout: delivery price is 15–25%% above spot!
gui.ammora.guide.contracts.line3: §e• Collateral (10%%): pledged on accept, returned on fulfillment.
gui.ammora.guide.contracts.line4: §f• Fulfillment: 'Deliver N' deducts items from inventory.
gui.ammora.guide.contracts.line5: §6• Reward: CBX payout + reputation (REP) rank progression.
gui.ammora.guide.contracts.line7: §8• New contracts spawn at midnight; replenish stock.
gui.ammora.guide.chart.title: §6§l[CHART] Candlestick Chart & Events
gui.ammora.guide.chart.line2: §f• Candle body: Open and Close; wicks: Low and High.
gui.ammora.guide.chart.line3: §f• Volume bars below: total player trade volume in period.
gui.ammora.guide.chart.line4: §e• Zoom: mouse wheel scales from 6 to 85 visible candles.
gui.ammora.guide.chart.line5: §e• Pan: click and drag with LMB to view historical candles.
gui.ammora.guide.chart.line6: §6• Market Events [NEWS]: Gold Rush, Copper Boom, etc.
gui.ammora.guide.chart.line8: §8• Pixel-perfect responsive rendering across all GUI scales.
gui.ammora.guide.redstone.title: §c§l[REDSTONE] Automation & Logistics
gui.ammora.guide.redstone.line1: §f• Pin [✔ Pin]: outputs comparator signal for chosen asset.
gui.ammora.guide.redstone.line3: §e• Broker Rank (2500 REP): unlocks advanced threshold triggers.
gui.ammora.guide.redstone.line4: §a• Trade Dock: auto-selling with Stop-Loss protection
gui.ammora.guide.redstone.line6: §b• Purchase Dock: auto-buys on redstone with Stop-High.
gui.ammora.guide.redstone.line7: §d• Create Display: live quotes to Flap Displays & Boards.
gui.ammora.guide.redstone.line8: §8• CC: Tweaked: 12+ Lua methods for automated trade bots.
